_comment: QEC config for tools/qtg — the Quantum Tree Generator of arXiv:2310.06623 (Box 1) on KP_4(p, w; 7), STATE PREPARATION ONLY. Reached through CQOPS_QEC_CONFIG. || WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: the Ry/Rz synthesis accuracy. libcqops reads that from CQOPS_QEC_PRECISION (src/sink_qec.c:122) and tools/qtg sets it from QTG_RY_EPSILON in instance.h. The `rotation` block this schema accepts configures qec_rz_configured's single golden angle, NOT the per-call qec_rz the sink uses, so putting the accuracy there would be silently inert. || LAYOUT IS COMB, NOT THE DEFAULT ABSTRACT: only comb builds a real 2-D grid with routing corridors, congestion and lattice-surgery routes between adjacent tiles, i.e. actual nearest-neighbour connectivity. Abstract models no placement at all and, per docs/FLOORPLAN_AND_DEPTH.md, ignores factory_count entirely ('abstract mode always runs exactly one'). d_max must be odd and >= the derived distance; n_gates_hint sizes d_max when d_max is unset. || Only the literal key `_comment` is accepted, one per object level — every other unknown key is a hard error (PRD v2 §10 / Rule 1).

hardware._comment: platform and topology each accept EXACTLY ONE value (src/config.c:14-15), so 'superconducting, nearest neighbour' is not a choice to make — square_lattice IS the nearest-neighbour surface-code lattice, and any other string is a hard config error. floor_plan likewise accepts only fast_block.

circuit._comment: epsilon here is the TOTAL ACCEPTABLE CIRCUIT ERROR (1/3), not the rotation accuracy -- that is QTG_RY_EPSILON in instance.h, reaching the library as CQOPS_QEC_PRECISION. n_logical is MINTED, not peak: the qec sink disables index recycling (PRD 15 D21(b)), so it must cover every qubit the program ever takes -- measured 126 at uniform 4-bit qints, where peak is only 35. n_clifford_estimate and epsilon derive the code distance (COST_SCALING.md: per_clifford_error = (epsilon/2)/(n_clifford*n_logical)); n_t_estimate provably does NOT -- compute_code_distance takes it and discards it.
